# Pinax vault overlay: local alias space becomes a path at --vault-root.
# .pinax stays on the vault root; notes is a symlink into the space content.

mkdir remote-files
mkdir local
exec sh -c 'printf hello > remote-files/a.txt'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space docs --remote-path $WORK/remote-files --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout '"status":"success"'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf preset pinax-vault --space docs --vault-root $WORK/vault --json
stdout '"preset":"pinax-vault"'
stdout '"writable":true'
stdout '"vault_root"'
stdout 'pinax init'

exists $WORK/vault/.drivebridge-pinax-vault.json
exec test -L $WORK/vault/notes
exec sh -c 'printf hi > "$1/vault/notes/from-pinax.md"' sh $WORK
exists $WORK/remote-files/notes/from-pinax.md

mkdir $WORK/vault/.pinax
exec sh -c 'printf x > "$1/vault/.pinax/config.yaml"' sh $WORK
! exists $WORK/remote-files/.pinax/config.yaml

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state mount status --json
stdout '"preset":"pinax-vault"'
stdout '"alive":true'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf preset pinax-vault --space docs --vault-root $WORK/other --json
stdout 'mount_already_running'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state mount stop --json
stdout '"stopped":true'
! exists $WORK/vault/notes
exists $WORK/vault/.pinax/config.yaml
exists $WORK/remote-files/notes/from-pinax.md

# Capsa-looking prefix is refused.
mkdir capsa-root
mkdir capsa-root/workspaces
exec sh -c 'printf "{}\n" > capsa-root/protocol.json'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space capsa --remote-path $WORK/capsa-root --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf preset pinax-vault --space capsa --vault-root $WORK/capsa-vault --json
stdout 'preset_prefix_is_capsa'

exec drivebridge capabilities --state $WORK/state --json
stdout 'cli_only'
stdout 'pinax-vault'
! stdout 'mount_start'
